metadata.title: SkyWire-PSInstaller
metadata.description:
This module automates a complete install a SkyWire POS ecosystem, including databases, web applications, and a desktop installer. 
  By default, empty databases are created, though you may specify a URL for a valid bacpac file upon which to base initial data.
  Note that this module requires the existence of several environment variables to locate and download the appropriate files.
  Please see officialy SkyWire documentation on this module for additional detals.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-SWDatabase' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
